data.name: Asyhab
data.gender_notes: Asyhab is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘ash-hab’, meaning ‘the honored ones’. This name is mentioned in the Hadith and is associated with the companions of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh). The name Asyhab carries the meaning “Honorable” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Asyhab usually hope their child will grow to embody honorable and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: To be among the righteous and honored in the sight of Allah.
data.etymology: Asyhab belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Honorable.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Asyhab total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: أسيهب
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من السحاب والرعد والبرق
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي، مشتق من السحاب والرعد والبرق، ويعني الظل الداكن أو السحاب الممطر، وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة الفرقان الآية 2 {'وَالسَّمَاءِ وَمَا بَنَاهَا'}، وهناك عدة أسماء في الإسلام تحمل معاني متعلقة بالطبيعة والكائنات السماوية.

in_urdu.name: اسیہب
in_urdu.meaning: اسم مشتق من السحاب والرعد والبرق، معنی ہے بادل یا مेघ
in_urdu.long_meaning: اسیہب علم کا ایک مذکر نام ہے، جو عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے، اس کا مطلب ہے بادل یا مےغ، جو کہ ایک قدرتی چیز ہے، قرآن مجید میں سورة الفرقان کی آیت 2 میں اس کا ذکر آیا ہے، {'وَالسَّمَاءِ وَمَا بَنَاهَا'}، اسلامی تقویم میں کئی نام ایسے ہیں جو قدرتی چیزوں سے وابستہ ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: अस्यहब
in_hindi.meaning: बादल या घनघोर मेघ से लिया गया नाम
in_hindi.long_meaning: अस्यहब एक पुल्लिंग नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है बादल या घनघोर मेघ, यह नाम प्राकृतिक तत्वों से जुड़ा हुआ है, कुरआन में सूरतुल फ्रिकान की आयत 2 में {'وَالسَّمَاءِ وَمَا بَنَاهَا'} इसका जिक्र है, इस्लामी परंपरा में कई नाम हैं जो प्राकृतिक वस्तुओं से संबंधित हैं।

in_pashto.name: اسیہب
in_pashto.meaning: د بادلونو او ورځو او برښناو څخه اخیستل شوی نوم
in_pashto.long_meaning: اسیہب یو مذکر نوم دی چی د عربی ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، معنی یی د بادل یا میغ دی، دا نوم د طبیعي شیانو څخه اخیستل شوی دی، قران مجید کې د فرقان سورت په آیت 2 کې {'وَالسَّمَاءِ وَمَا بَنَاهَا'} ددی ذکر شوی دی، په اسلامی کیلنڈر کې ډیری نومونه د طبیعي شیانو سره تړاو لري.

in_english.name: Asyhab
in_english.meaning: Derived from cloud, thunder and lightning
in_english.long_meaning: Asyhab is a masculine given name of Arabic origin, meaning cloud or thundercloud, it is associated with natural elements, referenced in Quranic verse, Surah Al-Furqan 2 {'وَالسَّمَاءِ وَمَا بَنَاهَا'}, symbolizing divine power and creation, carrying spiritual significance and cultural importance across Islamic tradition.

data.cultural_impact: The name 'Asyhab' holds great cultural significance as a tribute to the early Muslim community and their companions who stood by the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and helped spread Islam. Naming a child 'Asyhab' is a way to honor the sacrifices and contributions of these early Muslims and to inspire future generations with their stories of bravery, resilience, and unwavering faith.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name 'Asyhab' symbolizes respect, reverence, and admiration for the companions and their unwavering devotion to the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh). It serves as a reminder of the importance of following in the footsteps of the Prophet and his companions who dedicated their lives to living out the teachings of Islam. This name instills qualities of patience, humility, and courage in the child and motivates them to strive for excellence in their faith and character.

historical_references.reference: Asyhab were the ten companions of the Prophet Muhammad who were given the title of 'Ashab al-Kahf' (People of the Cave). They fled to a cave in Mecca to protect themselves from persecution during the early Islamic period. The story of the Asyhab and their stay in the cave is narrated in Surah Al-Kahf (Chapter 18) of the Quran.
historical_references.time_period: Pre-Islamic Arabia to Early Islamic Period
historical_references.context: Religious persecution and hiding in a cave for protection.

historical_references.reference: Asyhab refers to a group of Islamic scholars and teachers known as the 'Ash'ab al-Rasul' (Companions of the Prophet). They were the earliest students of the Prophet Muhammad and played a crucial role in the spread of Islam during the formative years of the Islamic Ummah. The Asyhab were instrumental in recording and transmitting the Hadith and interpreting Islamic law based on the teachings of the Prophet.
historical_references.context: Islamic education and transmission of Hadith.

modern_usage.modern_context: The term 'Asyhab' refers to the ten companions of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) who were his close friends and allies during his mission in Mecca and Medina. In modern context, the term is used across various platforms to signify a deep sense of companionship, camaraderie, and spiritual connection. On Instagram, Asyhab is represented through beautifully curated accounts showcasing Islamic art, calligraphy, and quotes from the Quran and Hadiths. On YouTube, Asyhab is a popular term in the Islamic self-help and spirituality community, where it's used to describe groups of individuals who inspire and motivate one another to live a more pious and righteous life. On Facebook, Asyhab groups serve as communities for Muslims to connect with one another, share resources, and provide support. Overall, Asyhab represents a modern interpretation of the traditional Islamic concept of companionship and the importance of community in the spiritual journey.
